intro: Afghanistan is one of the poorest countries in the world, and its economy shrank sharply after 2021.

chapters.title: Farming
text: Most people farm or herd. Afghanistan grows wheat, fruit, nuts and saffron, and exports dried fruit, carpets and coal. It was long the world's biggest grower of opium poppies, which the Taliban banned in 2022.

chapters.title: Minerals
text: The mountains hold copper, iron, lithium and gems like lapis lazuli, which has been mined here for 6,000 years.

keyTerms.meaning: A deep-blue stone mined in Badakhshan.
